title: Stall-guard wk-exemption (ref)
desc: Incidents and history behind the stall-guard / pace wk-exemption: the 4-copy hyphen drift and the launcher Catch-22.
steps: INCIDENT 2026-06-23: the wk-exemption inline regex used wk-followed-by-word-chars-only (no hyphen) in FOUR guard copies -- Test-WkPaceVerdict in wkharness-guards-pace.ps1, the wk-only-gate in wkharness-guards-shell.ps1 (twice, identical if/else branches), and wkharness-guards-gemini.ps1. A hyphenated ./wk-cdp.cmd launcher was wrongly pace/wk-only BLOCKED even though bare wkappbot/wkedit passed. guards-pace fixed in commit d7a3ddba; guards-shell and guards-gemini pending.

ROOT-CAUSE CLASS: duplicate exemption lists that drift. A shared Test-WkPaceExempt exists but the gates inline their own copy, so each drifts independently. NO-BANDAID fix: route all copies through the one shared function.
RELATED: the delegation-launcher Catch-22 (a launcher command itself getting stall-counted) was fixed via the heart-v2 launcher exemption; the stall window resets on a successful delegation.
author: claude
